To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we introduce the first extension of differential privacy to complex-valued data and we present the first differentially private algorithm for training complex-valved neural networks.

we propose a new notion of DP for complex-valued functions and that we show that it is possible to train complex-valued neural network with DP-SGD with excellent utility and rigorous privacy guarantees.

we introduce the $\zeta$ -DP, an extension to complex-valued differential privacy (DP), we present a complex-valued stochastic gradient descent ($ \zeta$ - DP-SGD) and we evaluate $\zeta $ -DP-SGD for training neural networks on three real-world complex-valued tasks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
extending DP to complex-valued deep learning, and we hope it will be of interest to the DP community and the machine learning community alike.
the development of a new DP framework for the privacy-preserving training of complex-valuid neural networks.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
complex-valued deep learning is possible with rigorous guarantees of differential privacy.
complex-valued deep learning is a promising direction of future research in the area of differential privacy.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a framework for training complex-valuued neural networks with differential privacy, which we experimentally evaluate and benchmark on a large variety of tasks.
we present a new extension of differential privacy for complex-valued functions, and we show that complex-valued neural network training can be performed with differential privacy.
complex-valued deep learning is now possible with differential privacy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the complex domain can be a natural choice for DP training of neural networks.
the complex-valued setting provides a rich playground to explore the limits of differential privacy.
DP can be extended to complex-valued neural nets, thus enabling a wider range of applications.
